notes.title: Devlog #2 - Gearing Up For Playtest: New Systems, New Feel
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello scavengers, sellers, and sharp-eyed shopkeepers![/b][/p][p]The next public playtest is almost here - and with it, the biggest leap Pawnbroker Simulator has taken since the first demo. Over the past few months, we’ve reimagined, restructured, and refined key systems based on everything you told us (and everything we felt still needed doing).[/p][p]This devlog isn’t just a changelog - it’s a preview of what you’ll experience soon: smarter customers, clearer feedback, and a smoother, more expressive gameplay foundation. Whether you’re here to min-max profits or build the weirdest, grimiest pawn empire imaginable - this one’s for you.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]✨ What’s Been Transformed[/h2][p]Before we talk about what’s ahead, let’s focus on what’s now [b]fully real[/b], fully playable, and built with your feedback in mind.[/p][p][/p][h3]🗣 A New Tutorial (That Doesn't Talk Down To You)[/h3][p]Say goodbye to being dragged through rigid steps. The new tutorial system is guided by [b]Uncle Barry[/b], a warm, sarcastic voice in your ear who nudges, not nags. Lines like:[/p][quote][p][i]"Store’s lookin’ like it’s been sealed in a tomb. Grab something and clean the place up a little—window, floor, shelves. Even rats don’t walk into filth."[/i][/p][/quote][p]...set the tone. You’ll get [b]voice-guided moments[/b], but you won’t be forced. You’ll also unlock access to a [b]How To Play[/b] page— an encyclopedia of mechanics, if you choose to dive deep. It’s a complete rework aimed at player agency and clarity.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117447/f87ede6b535f2943ffe5c6cd2226ac9ba67c582d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117447/827f835e47774f63d22d68f9c462662fb1b0a165.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h3]🧹 Store Appeal is Real Now — And It Talks Back[/h3][quote][p][i]"Customers love a clean store. You know who doesn’t? Roaches. Choose a side." [b]~ Uncle Barry[/b][/i][/p][/quote][p]Let’s be honest: in the demo, [b]store appeal was a ghost[/b]. You didn’t see it, didn’t feel it, and it barely mattered. That’s done.[/p][p]Now, the store's appeal is:[/p][list][*][p]Based on [b]placement near the storefront[/b], [b]customizations[/b], [b]cleanliness[/b], [b]reputation[/b], and [b]item condition/rarity[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Visually reinforced[/b] with placement indicators, bonus feedback, and grime decals[/p][/*][*][p][b]Directly tied to customer spawns[/b] — more appeal, more foot traffic[/p][/*][*][p]Backed by [b]customer reviews[/b], and those reviews now form your [b]reputation[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Customers no longer enter your store silently. They admire, complain, praise, or recoil — and their star ratings now shape your business.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117447/0991feaaba4eccdbd97936bd9ee9881bac70d069.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117447/51997df07ac4bbe1b2da945c0d16198e2e25ea63.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h3]🧠 Customers Now Think (and Wait)[/h3][quote][p][i]"They used to leave if someone sneezed near the item they are interested in. Now they wait like real people — grumpy, impatient, and judging your layout."[/i][/p][p][i][b]~ Uncle Barry[/b][/i][/p][/quote][p]Buyers used to act like impatient ghosts. If too many people stood near items, they'd skip them entirely and vanish. Now?[/p][list][*][p]If something's blocked, they find [b]a calm spot[/b] and wait.[/p][/*][*][p]If attraction is too low, they tell you: [i]“Low Attraction.”[/i][/p][/*][*][p]If they’re interested but the price is steep: [i]“Too Expensive.”[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]This overhaul makes the shop feel like a real space, where [b]negotiation opportunities arise naturally[/b] instead of being hindered by pathfinding quirks.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45117447/2bd46797be22fc2aa11ce5d78decfa662b53ff88.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]📊 Your Skills, Now Front and Center[/h3][p]We now show you the [b]relevant skills and knowledge[/b] in context, right when they matter:[/p][list][*][p]Examining an item? You’ll see your [b]Appraiser[/b] and [b]Analyst[/b] levels right there.[/p][/*][*][p]Haggling? Your [b]Negotiator[/b] badge shows up, too.[/p][/*][/list][p]This transparency makes your [b]progression visible[/b] and helps you understand which systems are empowering which outcomes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45117447/18d39f2ffed262e54c6530350c2ed3084ba7dbf3.png"][/img][/p][h3]🔍 Examining Items is Now Visually Clear[/h3][p]Previously, the examination system was a foggy mess. You never knew:[/p][list][*][p]How many points were available[/p][/*][*][p]Which ones were revealed[/p][/*][*][p]Or which ones you’d clicked[/p][/*][/list][p]Now? It’s clean.[/p][list][*][p]Each [b]Examination Point (EP)[/b] is represented by a chip.[/p][/*][*][p]Chips animate when revealed (via rotation/zoom) and again when clicked.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Auto-examined points[/b] are marked upfront.[/p][/*][/list][p]It’s now a tactile, informative, and dare we say, satisfying part of your day.[/p][p][/p][h3]🔗 Synergy Lines — Because Placement Matters Now[/h3][quote][p][i]"Matching items talk to each other now. Not literally. But if your CRT TV and your 90s camcorder fall in love, don’t say I didn’t warn you."[/i][/p][p][i][b]~ Uncle Barry[/b][/i][/p][/quote][p]We’ve implemented a new [b]synergy feedback system[/b] that shows clear, visual connections between items that belong together — think EAFC[i] Ultimate Team squad builder[/i], but for pawned goods.[/p][list][*][p]Put two items from the same [b]type[/b] near each other? You’ll see a [b]glowing line[/b] between them.[/p][/*][*][p]Stack matching items in a focused display? That attraction bonus isn’t just imagined — it’s real, and you’ll feel it.[/p][/*][/list][p]This makes organizing your store [b]strategic[/b], not just aesthetic. Build themed displays. Create rare clusters. Or just enjoy the satisfaction of watching your collectibles [i]link up[/i].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//45117447/f87ede6b535f2943ffe5c6cd2226ac9ba67c582d.png"][/img][/p][h3]⭐ A Reputation System That Feels Like Yelp (In a Good Way)[/h3][quote][p][i]"Reviews are in. One guy said your store felt like a crime scene. Another cried in a good way. You’re at 3.5 stars — just like my blood pressure."[/i][/p][p][i][b]~ Uncle Barry[/b][/i][/p][/quote][p]The old reputation UI is gone. In its place is a [b]review-based reputation system[/b] that simulates actual customer logic.[/p][p]Each customer leaves a review based on:[/p][list][*][p]One [b]main focus[/b] (70% of the score)[/p][/*][*][p]Two [b]auxiliary focuses[/b] (15% each)[/p][/*][/list][p]These focuses range from [b]Store Atmosphere[/b] to [b]Shopping Outcome[/b], and the feedback is always specific. Your [b]reputation score[/b] is now the average of your [b]last 20 reviews[/b], meaning every interaction counts.[/p][p]There’s also a helpful [b]tooltip panel[/b] that breaks down:[/p][list][*][p]Item spawn effects[/p][/*][*][p]Bonus systems[/p][/*][*][p]Appeal influence[/p][/*][/list][p]You’re not flying blind anymore.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🔭 What’s On The Horizon[/h2][p]After this milestone, here’s what’s heading your way for the [b]August and September milestones[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]120+ new items[/b], across dozens of categories[/p][/*][*][p][b]Item synergy mechanics[/b] based on age, brand, and rarity[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bulk dealing[/b] support[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stacking, tagging, and inventory overhauls[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]More nuanced progression[/b] with revamped feedback in every major system[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re moving fast. And carefully.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]💬 Join Us[/h2][quote][p][i]"Come hang in Discord. We got pawn jokes, hot takes, and at least two people who know what they’re doing. Maybe you’ll be the third."[/i][/p][p][i][b]~ Uncle Barry[/b][/i][/p][/quote][p]This playtest is not just about stability — it’s about [b]collaboration[/b]. We’re shaping a game that rewards wit, strategy, and weirdly specific interior design choices. If that sounds like your thing...[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/2veJQeKmBc" style="button"]Join the Discord Channel[/url][/p][p]Let’s build something sharp, funny, and deep — together.[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]- The Pawnbroker Simulator Team [/i][/b][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Demo Disabled - Improvements Incoming!
notes.content: [p]Thank you all for checking out the demo and sharing your invaluable feedback! We've temporarily disabled the demo to focus on polishing the game, addressing your suggestions, and introducing exciting new features. You can read more about it here: [dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3104420/announcements/detail/520843384949047947"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]But don't worry - an updated preview build is already in the works and will be available through Steam Playtests soon. If you'd like to help us shape the game further, you can sign up for the Playtests right now![/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3845000"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Stay tuned, and thanks for joining us on this journey![/p]

notes.title: Devlog #1 — What We Learned From the Demo
notes.content:
[p]Hello pledgers and pawnbrokers![/p][p]Our first public demo is out in the world — and the response was incredible. We received tons of thoughtful, in-depth feedback from you. This devlog is our way of reflecting on what worked, what didn’t, and what’s next. Your input has shaped our roadmap more than you might think.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]✅ What Worked Well[/h2][p]Based on your feedback, here’s what we’re keeping — and why:[/p][list][*][p][b]Item Variety Enhances Immersion[/b]
The abundance of items helped you stay in the flow, wondering what might show up next. This uncertainty turned out to be key in making the shop feel alive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dynamic Haggling is Engaging[/b]
The haggling system was praised for providing a satisfying challenge — trying to buy low and sell high created constant tension.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customer Personalities Add Depth[/b]
Many of you noticed that repeating the same haggling strategy doesn't always work. Each customer reacts differently based on their traits, adding a layer of unpredictability that you enjoyed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Store Customization Matters[/b]
The ability to shape your shop’s appearance made players feel more connected to their space. A cozy, well-designed shop draws more attention — and more buyers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Skills & Knowledge Feel Rewarding[/b]
Choosing which path to improve — whether you're becoming a negotiation shark or a category expert — gives a strong sense of progression and mastery.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🛠 What Needs Work[/h2][p]Not everything clicked — here’s what we’re fixing:[/p][list][*][p][b]Too Few Buyers[/b]
Earning profit felt sluggish. Without enough direct buyers, flipping items often didn’t feel worth it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Checkout Queue Frustrations[/b]
Our single shared queue let sellers dominate the line, causing buyers to leave before being served.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial Was Overwhelming[/b]
Long blocks of forced text and rigid steps bogged players down early on, making the experience feel more like a chore than a discovery.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lack of System Feedback[/b]
Many of you didn’t even realize mechanics like item synergy, store appeal, or auto-evaluation existed — that’s on us. We need to make systems more transparent and reactive.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🔁 What We're Changing[/h2][p]Here’s what’s already in progress for the next update:[/p][list][*][p][b]Revamped Checkout Queue[/b]
We’re splitting the queue by customer type. Some slots will now be reserved for buyers and pledgers, ensuring smoother gameplay and better profits.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Browsing Behavior Overhaul[/b]
Potential buyers will now include "just browsing" types who wander the store instead of crowding display items. This solves pathfinding problems and gives the shop a more natural rhythm.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Item Catalog Cleanup[/b]
We’re reorganizing item types, categories, brands, and age tags to make more sense — and to better support synergy-based mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p][b]A New Tutorial with Uncle Barry[/b]
Say goodbye to rigid text blocks. Uncle Barry (your father’s old friend) will now guide you via voice messages in a laid-back, natural style. Tooltips will appear only when needed — like in Frostpunk — and players can re-read them anytime via the menu.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]➕ What We Plan To Add[/h2][p]While our focus is on polish, a few new additions are still coming — and they’re worth getting excited about:[/p][list][*][p][b]New Store Environment[/b]
We’ve completely revamped the world your store lives in. You didn’t see it in the demo because... well, we were secretly building it behind the scenes. It’s nearly ready.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Signs & Logos[/b]
Fresh signage will soon give your store more character and visual personality. This update is almost finished.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bulk Trading[/b]
Some sellers will now come in with boxes of comics, toys, or other related items. Likewise, buyers might go on themed shopping sprees. Synergy matters more than ever.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reputation Panel[/b]
A new UI element will show you exactly how you’re doing with your store’s reputation. It’ll give actionable feedback on mistakes and graces, so you’ll know how to rise — or avoid falling.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117447/84df48d979daca43078c713ccf5e9e057a0ac30f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117447/ef6cab7f070d1396279f59f4102d4086340ea587.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117447/1489e04c2b37ae297d54bb675efcfd8e570d2f5b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117447/fc67b9c6f0e0fbdbbfdcc7f26f8007a3284be0d9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117447/33cabf7a76b45a7c7dccdcfdae46c79c84e0d1fb.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117447/8065d3e5d6aab928a9c95bc060b4f64aa663e436.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🧠 Community Highlights[/h2][p]Here are just a few things you’ve said that made us smile:[/p][quote][p][i]“I really like the skill feature — it adds complexity to the game, which I appreciate.”[/i]
— John[/p][/quote][quote][p][i]“This is the BEST Pawn Shop Game I've Ever Played.”[/i]
— MistaH1N1[/p][/quote][quote][p][i]“Not gonna lie, the first dude who came in with the rifle gave me a good scare.”[/i]
— Feanor[/p][/quote][hr][/hr][p]We can’t thank you enough for your support and insight. You’re not just testers — you’re co-architects of this world. Onward to the next update![/p][p]Please consider joining our Discord channel to help us shape this game into perfection or just to share some time together! [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/2veJQeKmBc " style="button"]Join the Discord Channel[/url][/p][p]— The Pawnbroker Simulator Team 🔍

[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix V0.5.12 (Sad Glossy Hammer)
notes.content: [p]Thanks to your continued feedback and sharp insights, we’ve got another round of fixes and improvements hot off the shelf. From livelier storefronts to smarter tutorials and smoother customer queues, we’re fine-tuning the experience to keep your hustle as seamless as possible.[/p][p]Whether you’re chasing profits, dodging shady deals, or just trying to catch a good night’s sleep—we’ve got your back.[/p][p]As always, if you spot anything funky or have fresh ideas, swing by our [b]Discord[/b] or drop a line on the [b]Community Hub[/b]. Let’s keep building this thing together.[/p][p][/p][p]🧾 Keep the shelves stocked and the customers talking — The Dev Team 💼[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/2veJQeKmBc " style="button"]Join Our Discord Channel[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog[/h2][list][*][p][b]Idle Animations for Examination Points[/b][/p][p]We added subtle idle animations to item examination points to help catch your eye when they’re explored.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bigger Customer Queue[/b][/p][p]Now, up to four customers can line up at the counter, and sellers won't stop buyers from getting in line.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Security and Sleeping Tutorials[/b][/p][p]The security tutorial now begins on the first night, rather than when the store closes for the first time. The sleeping tutorial begins right after the security tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial Panel Reminder Animation[/b][/p][p]Added a gentle nudge to the tutorial panel to prevent players from missing key moments.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Control Hints for Money[/b][/p][p]The money customers hand over now displays same controls hints that the customer displays.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Exhibition Showcase Interaction Bug[/b][/p][p]Fixed an issue that would block interaction with the exhibition display.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix V0.5.11 (Sad Matte Hammer)
notes.content:
[p]Business never sleeps—and neither do we! Since the demo launched, you've been incredible: bringing in your thoughts, feedback, and sharp eyes from all corners of the community. Thanks to your hustle, we've been digging through the clutter, fixing what’s broken, and polishing up the shelves.[/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117447/4d0fb26beb367cf88cde47ff00702009346b1153.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117447/c78866bd7cfa5a521c39e2411a6de7ceb93d3034.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117447/5501dd6a607a980043ee79f9419a042365cf28fe.png"][/img][/carousel][p]We’re still digging through the attic of bugs and shiny feature ideas. If something feels off, [i]don’t be shy[/i]—drop by our [b]Discord[/b] or leave a note on the [b]Community Hub[/b]. Your input keeps our shelves stocked and the experience top-notch.[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/2veJQeKmBc " style="button"]Join Our Discord Channel[/url][/p][p]🧾 Keep hustling, keep haggling— [b]The Dev Team[/b] 💼[/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog[/h2][list][*][p][b]Version Names Added:[/b]
Each update now has a name (like [i]Sad Matte Hammer[/i]) for easier tracking. You can find it in the bottom-right corner of the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Language Start-Up Bug Fixed:[/b]
The game no longer starts in unsupported languages. More language options will be added in the future.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NumPad Pricing Support:[/b]
You can now use the NumPad to enter prices. Press NumPad Enter to confirm pricing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pricing Caret:
[/b]For quality of life, we added a caret to the pricing interface.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Brand Label Visibility:[/b]
Brand visuals have been redesigned to make the text more readable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Localization and Spelling Fixes:[/b]
Several translation, formatting, and spelling issues have been corrected.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: 💼 Pawnbroker Simulator – Demo Available Now!
notes.content: [p]The demo for [b]Pawnbroker Simulator[/b] is now live![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3468130/Pawnbroker_Simulator_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Step into the world of second-hand hustle - evaluate goods, haggle with customers, decorate your store, and build your reputation from scratch. Whether you're flipping antiques or avoiding scams, every deal counts.[/p][p]This is a work-in-progress slice of the game, and we're excited to share it early. There's plenty to explore already, and your feedback will help us make it even better.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠  Demo Content?[/h3][p][b]Build, expand, and customize.[/b] [/p][p]Redesign your shop with new furniture, wall colors, lighting, plants, and signage. Pay rent, keep the lights on, and use your tablet to order displays and decor.[/p][p][b]Evaluate second-hand items.[/b] [/p][p]Over 100 unique items to inspect and appraise. Look for engravings, test buttons, plug things in, and decide what it's worth. If you're unsure, take a few photos and get a second opinion from an expert.[/p][p][b]Master the art of the deal.[/b] Every customer has a personality. Some haggle hard, others just want a quick sale. Use the custom-designed interface to keep track of offers, slide your next bid, and learn when to walk away.[/p][p][b]Attract more customers.[/b][/p][p]Decorate your storefront, play with layout and item synergy, and raise your reputation to keep the foot traffic flowing.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]💬 We'd love your feedback[/h3][p]This demo is just the start, and we're actively building the rest of the game based on what you (players) think.[/p][p]If you’ve got a few minutes, we’d appreciate you filling out a short form. It helps a lot — and as a small thank-you, we’ll randomly select [b]5 participants[/b] to receive a free full-game key at launch.[/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/nLNM8BziKQutxEVg9" style="button"]Player Survey[/url][/p][p][/p]
